capabilities: Archive WeChat Official Account articles from the WeRead shelf as Markdown notes
Log in once via QR code and poll for new articles on a configurable schedule
Download images, audio and video locally and embed them in notes
Bulk-archive an account's full article history with batch controls and retries
Optionally summarize or process articles via an LLM endpoint or a local agent CLI
disambiguation: Not a WeRead book-highlights syncer like the existing obsidian-weread-plugin; it archives WeChat Official Account (公众号) articles, and the README says the two can be installed together.
extras: Desktop only (Electron webview login; needs Obsidian 1.13.0+). Stores WeRead credentials in plaintext in data.json inside the vault. Uses private WeRead APIs; the README documents strict rate-limit budgets because over-polling can get the user's WeRead account temporarily blocked. The plugin itself is free; AI processing is optional and uses the user's own key.
motivation: The author says these articles are '读完就散' (scattered after reading) and wanted to keep long-form pieces permanently in one's own notes instead of losing them to dead links.
problem: WeChat Official Account articles live in feeds and chats as links that eventually die, and Obsidian has no built-in way to archive them with their media intact.

relations.evidence: 微信读书接口与登录方式参考 zhaohongxuan/obsidian-weread-plugin（MIT）：扫码登录采用同一条路线
交互与阅读面范式参考 joeseesun/qiaomu-ai-rss（GPL-3.0-only）

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint key (for AI processing)
Local agent CLI (Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, CodeBuddy, Cursor)

summary: Archives WeChat Official Account articles from your WeRead shelf into the vault as local Markdown, with images and audio/video downloaded locally.
